# ShelfVitals

> Read-only sync auditing for multichannel Shopify stores. ShelfVitals
> compares marketplace listings (Faire, Amazon, Etsy, eBay — more coming)
> against the store's live Shopify inventory and alerts the merchant the
> moment they drift: oversell risk, underselling, dead or suppressed
> listings, price divergence, and marketplace orders that failed to import.

Key facts:
- Problem: sync apps fail silently (missed webhooks, expired tokens, broken
  listing links) while marketplaces keep selling stale stock. Sync apps
  rarely alert on their own failures.
- ShelfVitals does NOT sync anything and requests no write permissions
  anywhere. It never stores buyer personal information.
- Works alongside any sync setup (Shopify Marketplace Connect, CedCommerce,
  LitCommerce, Trunk, or manual).
- Pricing: Starter $19/mo (2 marketplaces, daily audits, email alerts),
  Pro $39/mo (unlimited marketplaces, hourly audits, SMS/Slack, suppressed-
  listing and missed-order detection).
- Status: early access — waitlist at https://shelfvitals.com
- Sibling product: PixelVitals (pixelvitals.com), ad-tracking health
  monitoring. Both by CodeBucky LLC.
- Contact: hello@shelfvitals.com
